description: Evaluation-only synthetic multi-document corpus. It is isolated in a dedicated Elasticsearch index and must never be treated as production device truth.

documents.title: Prolonged Device Offline Troubleshooting
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. For a device that has been offline for a prolonged period, troubleshoot in this order: verify the power supply, verify SIM and data-plan status, check cellular network coverage, and then inspect firmware or runtime health. This is a troubleshooting procedure only and is not proof of the actual root cause.

documents.title: shadowStatus CONFLICT Semantics
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. shadowStatus CONFLICT means the reported device state and the desired platform shadow state disagree. It is a state-consistency indicator. CONFLICT by itself does not prove that the device is offline or that the broker connection failed.

documents.title: SignalStrength Field Semantics
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. SignalStrength is a reported telemetry field. SignalStrength=0 means the stored field value is zero. Without protocol-specific freshness and encoding rules, zero alone must not be promoted to a confirmed no-signal or disconnected diagnosis.

documents.title: PeripheralStatus Bit Semantics
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. PeripheralStatus uses binary flags in this corpus: bit0 indicates the lure-lamp circuit and bit1 indicates the camera circuit. For each defined bit, 0 means inactive and 1 means active. No meaning is defined here for bits above bit1.

documents.title: SIM and Data-plan Verification
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. Verify SIM presence, activation state, remaining data-plan validity, and account suspension status when diagnosing cellular connectivity. This passage intentionally does not define a carrier HTTP API endpoint or database table.

documents.title: Firmware and Runtime Health Inspection
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. Firmware and runtime health inspection should review reboot counters, watchdog resets, crash or exception logs, process uptime, and the most recent successful telemetry cycle. These observations support diagnosis but do not independently prove a root cause.

documents.title: Last-saved Property Snapshot Semantics
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. A property snapshot is the last saved state known to the platform. Historical snapshot values are not live telemetry unless their timestamps are fresh. queriedAt describes query time, while snapshotUpdatedAt describes when the stored snapshot was last updated.

documents.title: Thing-model Event History Semantics
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. Thing-model event history records device events exposed by the event feed. It is not an alarm feed. An empty result means no event records were returned by that query and must not be interpreted as proof that no alarm condition ever occurred.

documents.title: Reconnect Backoff Procedure
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. After an unexpected connection loss, a client should retry with bounded backoff instead of a tight reconnect loop. Increase the delay between repeated failures up to a configured ceiling and reset the delay after a stable connection is restored.

documents.title: Device Command Verification
documents.content: Evaluation-only synthetic knowledge. A successful command submission is not the same as verified device state. After a write command, query the authoritative device state with bounded verification attempts and report a verification timeout when the expected state cannot be observed.
